topic.source_contract: Water abstraction licensing, advice, application and public-register evidence

facts.guard: need-check guidance is not licence or water-availability confirmation
application is not grant or guaranteed quantity
pre-application advice is not a decision
historic licence details may not represent current holder or authorised quantity

facts.public_notice: certain applications are consulted and available on the public register
facts.guard: notice is an application record and not a licence grant

scope_guards: A requirement to apply is not a granted abstraction licence.
Pre-application advice is not a binding water-availability or licensing decision.
Surface-water and groundwater abstractions remain distinct.
An application or public notice is not authorised quantity, duration or operating status.
A licence may contain conditions, hands-off-flow restrictions and time limits that require exact review.
Change, transfer, vesting, revocation and expiry can alter historic licence evidence.
Water-resource licensing is distinct from planning permission, environmental permits and utility connection capacity.
No score or promotion is written without exact source, quantity, licence status, conditions, hydrology and site evidence.
